ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.8 (TieJin Modify) 绑定仪式观众助兴与选人提示：准备窗口排除主持和性奴的重复观众计数，结算按本场实际经过时间检查出席；观看至少半场的观众提供助兴，零观众为 +0%，十人及以上封顶 +20%，结果信件始终列出此项。 选人头像以金色鞭子表示主持候选、紫色项圈表示 SSC 性奴候选；悬停查看配对、当前条件与拒绝原因，斜线表示不可选，勾选表示已选。四语提示精简，并将候选称呼统一为“性奴”。身份过滤只用于候选图标，实际仪式资格沿用已有规则。 继承 2.3.7 猫狗特化与宠物互动、2.3.6 统一特化基础经验、2.3.5 自我调教及更早内容。基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护。锁链达到第 2 阶段的 SSC 性奴可按 RJW 原有条件被指派为泄欲对象。 宠物兔入口仍禁用，旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停；20% 亲昵自愿后续仍待实机验收。版本内容与验证范围见 CHANGELOG.md 和 Docs/Releases/2.3.8/。
Version 2.3.8 fixes Binding Ritual spectator bonuses and improves participant selection. The setup preview excludes the host and sex slave from spectator counts. Outcomes use actual elapsed ritual time and count spectators who attended at least half the ceremony: none gives +0%, ten or more cap at +20%. Result letters always show this factor. Gold whip icons mark host candidates and purple collars mark SSC Sex Slave candidates. Hover for pair conditions and rejection reasons; a slash marks unavailable and a check marks assigned. Selection copy is shorter in four languages and consistently names the sex slave. The identity filter applies to candidate icons; actual ritual admission follows existing rules. Retains 2.3.7 Cat/Dog specializations and pet interactions, 2.3.6 shared specialization progress, 2.3.5 self-training and earlier features. Continues from upstream 2.2.8. SSC Sex Slaves at Chain stage 2 or higher can be designated as RJW Comfort pawns under RJW's existing conditions. Rabbit selection remains disabled and legacy RimTalk remains suspended. In-game acceptance of the 20% consensual affection follow-up remains pending. See CHANGELOG.md and Docs/Releases/2.3.8/ for content and validation scope.
